svg.title: Claude Code on Foundry network and trust architecture
svg.desc: Customer-neutral source-verified overview of developer identity, gateway authorization, private registry, membership sync, project-specific Foundry backends, optional tenant and ingress wiring, and chargeback telemetry.

g.text: Claude Code on Foundry | identity, routing & private-network architecture
Integrated baseline and optional wiring • Customer-neutral design • Design / wiring requirements, not live acceptance
CUSTOMER ENTRA TENANT • identity / token trust boundary
DIRECTORY CONTROL PLANE • separate from Azure resource RBAC
Combined developer + Gateway API
Single-tenant public client • token v2
Delegated access_as_user • no secret
WAM / browser PKCE; device code optional
Consent + Conditional Access apply
Flat Entra security groups → Graph
Direct membership → project / STD / PRM / CYB
Stable group IDs authorize; names are snapshots
Sync UAMI: GroupMember.Read.All
+ User.Read.All + Application.Read.All
Separate internal Resolver API
No public-client redirects / developer scopes
EasyAuth pins APIM MI app ID AND object ID
APIM-only audience; no developer access
Azure Owner ≠ Entra administrator
DEVELOPER WORKSTATION
Claude Code CLI
VS Code Claude Code panel
Claude Desktop
Approved ccof-token helper
MSAL • secure broker / encrypted cache
Gateway API audience only
onboarding.json: strict schemaVersion 1
Config only • no grants / usage metering
No direct Foundry / resolver permission
OPTIONAL CUSTOMER INGRESS
Internal-only ingress / WAF / SIPA controls
Customer-approved access topology
Not universally created by quickstart
Dashed = optional, not proof of deployment
ADMINISTRATOR CONTROL PLANE
Cloud Shell • ARM / Graph / OneDeploy
Resource-specific Bicep modules
Network → resources → directory objects
→ remaining wiring → grants / config / code
→ registrySeed → client artifacts / tests
Entra and Azure roles held separately
Grant Graph before first timer token
Cached MI tokens can delay new roles
Ordinary Cloud Shell: no private data plane
No jumpbox / VM assumption
CORE AZURE SUBSCRIPTION • core resource group / approved region
AZURE API MANAGEMENT • cloud-managed service
Existing APIM usually • system-assigned MI enabled
① Validate tenant / audience / client / scope / person
x-ccof-project is intent, checked against entitlement
Admission cap + cached v3 / d3 resolver decision
Exact model admission; aggregate + family ceilings
Per-person AND group limits • never substitute backend
RESOLVER FUNCTION • Flex / system-assigned MI
② APIM-only EasyAuth • internal API audience
Resolve person + project → classification / backendId
Validated familyPolicy: haiku / sonnet / opus
Fable / Mythos: exact registration AND CYB only
Token-limits-only baseline; optional monetary mode
③ Least-privilege Cosmos reads over private SQL PE
SYNC FUNCTION • Flex / user-assigned MI
⑤ Microsoft Graph reads → entitlement projection
Successful run applies membership additions/removals
Freeze affected projects on failed reads; syncLease
Conflict: retain incumbent classification, otherwise none
registrySeed timer: create-only projects + backends
Verify readback; disable timer / clean payload after use
COSMOS DB • private SQL registry, outside VNet
Public access disabled + local auth off at creation
entitlement / projects / backends / subscriptionIndex
budgetState / aggregateBudgetState
syncLease / reconcilerLease
Resolver: reads; sync: scoped writes / seed creates
Reconciler: scoped budget writes • never broad keys
CUSTOMER VNET • core subscription + region • network boundary
APIM outbound subnet
Microsoft.Web/serverFarms delegation
Required NSG • approved routes / UDR
APIM compute is NOT in this subnet
Existing APIM is not auto-attached
Actual caller VNet must resolve / route
Functions outbound subnet
Microsoft.App/environments delegation
Resolver + sync + optional reconciler
Flex compute is NOT in this subnet
Outbound integration ≠ inbound PE
Separate from APIM subnet
PRIVATE-ENDPOINT SUBNET • NICs only
Baseline: Cosmos SQL + each app's blob PE
Optional: resolver sites PE (inbound only)
Optional: Foundry account PE(s), any subscription
PE approval and DNS / route must be verified
Target PaaS services remain outside this VNet
OPTIONAL RECONCILER • Flex / UAMI
LAW usage → budgetState / aggregateBudgetState
Monetary mode only; baseline has no reconciler timer
FunctionAppLogs diagnostics • reconcilerLease
PER-APP BLOB DEPLOYMENT STORAGE • outside VNet
Resolver / sync / optional reconciler • identity-based access
Public access disabled; shared-key auth off at creation
Separate blob private endpoint per app • OneDeploy packages
DESIGNATED BACKEND SUBSCRIPTION A • same tenant
PROJECT-SPECIFIC FOUNDRY ACCOUNT
④ set-backend-service → resolved backendId only
APIM system MI → cognitive resource token
Cognitive Services User grant on each target account
Accounts can live in different Azure subscriptions
Anthropic account base: /anthropic
Messages: /v1/messages • NOT /api/projects
Public/private exposure is backend-owner policy
Optional PEs are in caller's VNet, not here
DESIGNATED BACKEND SUBSCRIPTION B … N • same tenant
FOUNDRY ACCOUNT • additional project backend
Independent per-account MI grant / model deployments
Project backendId maps here, not to account A
Public/private per owner • optional caller-VNet PE
OPTIONAL DIFFERENT ENTRA TENANT
Foundry account + backend-tenant application credentials
Staged credential path; manual MI helper refuses cross-tenant
APIM-only credential custody / rotation • never client-distributed
Cross-tenant PE approval is independent of authentication
Not the Resolver API app; not the managed-identity baseline
AZURE MONITOR • core subscription / managed resources
⑥ APIM GatewayLogs + GatewayLlmLogs
+ sanitized trusted usage / resolver traces
Resolver + sync App Insights; Function logs
→ Log Analytics → full chargeback workbook + fixed rate card
Request-time person / group / project / model / family / backend
Disjoint input / output / cache read / write 5m / write 1h
Stream cache categories unknown, never guessed
No prompts / responses / credentials logged
Selectors are NOT authorization; list price ≠ invoice
PRIVATE DNS + CUSTOMER NETWORK RESPONSIBILITIES
Baseline: privatelink.documents.azure.com • privatelink.blob.core.windows.net
Optional inbound resolver: privatelink.azurewebsites.net
Optional Foundry: privatelink.cognitiveservices.azure.com / openai.azure.com / services.ai.azure.com
Link / forward from the ACTUAL APIM and Functions caller networks; hub peering does not share DNS
Customer owns approved custom DNS, firewall, UDR, hub / peering and ingress controls
REVOCATION / RECLASSIFICATION • bounded, not instantaneous
⑦ Group removal → successful sync → resolver / cache refresh → subsequent requests denied
Baseline allow TTL 120s; refusal 30s; extra last-known-good grace 3600s on resolver failure
Urgent: verify registry revoke, then deploy policy keyVersion • no eager generation eviction
Move A → B: remove A / prove deny / add B; dual classifications never silently upgrade
New spend stamps B; historical spend remains with A, never rewritten from today's directory
READING THIS OVERVIEW
BLUE solid arrows ①–④: synchronous auth / request dependency; response returns on the same request path
GREEN dashed arrows ⑤ / ⑦: asynchronous membership projection / revocation • PURPLE dotted ⑥: telemetry / reporting
ORANGE dashed: administrator control plane or optional credential / monetary path • GRAY dotted, no arrow: network association
Solid blue/green service boxes: integrated implementation baseline (not live acceptance); amber dashed: optional production wiring / monetary or cross-tenant path
Boundaries: dashed labeled tenant / subscription / VNet / subnet containers; cloud-managed PaaS runs OUTSIDE VNet
Source baseline: ADR-0026 / ADR-0028; manual + quickstart modules, gateway policy, CLIENTS / SYNC / CHARGEBACK (see ARCHITECTURE.md)
